cohort: The cohort consists of AFE patients and healthy controls from whom peripheral blood sequencing data (clinical specimens) were collected for RNA sequencing.
finding: The study identified two upregulated immune-related biomarkers, MMP9 and PPBP, in AFE samples, which demonstrated robust predictive accuracy for AFE probability and correlated significantly with specific immune cell types.
cross-section timing: At the time of clinical specimen collection from AFE patients and healthy controls.
